typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WF_GUID as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER as string,
		DISCOVERED_VERSION as string,
		DISCOVERY_SOURCE as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_ID as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		INSTALL_DATE as timestamp,
		INSTALL_LOCATION as string,
		DEVICE_GUID as string,
		INSTALLED_ON as string,
		LAST_DISCOVERED as timestamp,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_ID as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		PRIMARY_KEY as string,
		SOFTWARE_MODEL as string,
		PACKAGE_NAME as string,
		SPKG_GUID as string,
		TSC_RELEASE_ID as string,
		UNINSTALL_STRING as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		LAST_MATCHED_DATE as timestamp,
		TSC_PUBLISHER_ID as string,
		TSC_VERSION_ID as string,
		TSC_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		LAST_SCANNED as timestamp,
		PARENT_PRODUCT as string,
		PARENT_PRODUCT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TSC_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		SOFTWARE_MODEL as string,
		DISCOVERED_VERSION as string,
		DEVICE_GUID as string,
		SPKG_GUID as string,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		TSC_PUBLISHER_ID as string,
		UNINSTALL_STRING as string,
		PRIMARY_KEY as string,
		DISCOVERY_SOURCE as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		INSTALL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		INSTALLED_ON as string,
		LAST_DISCOVERED as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LAST_MATCHED_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PARENT_PRODUCT as string,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER as string,
		PARENT_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		TSC_VERSION_ID as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_ID as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LAST_SCANNED as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		WF_GUID as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_ID as string,
		TSC_RELEASE_ID as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		INSTALL_LOCATION as string,
		PACKAGE_NAME as string,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TSC_PRODUCT_ID,
		SOFTWARE_MODEL,
		DISCOVERED_VERSION,
		DEVICE_GUID,
		SPKG_GUID,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME,
		TSC_PUBLISHER_ID,
		UNINSTALL_STRING,
		PRIMARY_KEY,
		DISCOVERY_SOURCE,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION,
		INSTALL_DATE,
		INSTALLED_ON,
		LAST_DISCOVERED,
		LAST_MATCHED_DATE,
		ImportDate,
		PARENT_PRODUCT,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER,
		PARENT_PRODUCT_NAME,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		TSC_VERSION_ID,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		ENVIRONMENT_ID,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		SYS_CREATED_ON,
		LAST_SCANNED,
		WF_GUID,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_ID,
		TSC_RELEASE_ID,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY,
		INSTALL_LOCATION,
		PACKAGE_NAME,
		SYS_CREATED_BY,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
